MC-1.title: Timer-started Pre-Vote round survives leader establishment and makes the new leader re-elect
MC-1.cause: handle_tick_election starts a Pre-Vote round for a Candidate whose election timed out; establish_leader/become_leader do not clear pre_candidate, and handle_pre_vote_resp calls elect() on the round's quorum without re-checking role or vote.

MC-2.title: Completed Pre-Vote round elects a node that left the voters; its self-grant panics RaftCore
MC-2.cause: handle_pre_vote_resp calls elect() without the is_voter check performed by every old elect() caller; do_elect then builds a candidate over voters that exclude the node and the runtime's local self-grant reaches Candidate::grant_by, whose ex

MC-3.title: Repeated Pre-Vote round at the same hypothetical vote counts a delayed grant from a removed node; RaftCore panics
MC-3.cause: Rounds started at an unchanged vote probe the same (term+1, self); the PreVoteResponse gate correlates by leader id only, and handle_pre_vote_resp calls grant_by for any granted response, which panics for a node outside the new round's quor
